title: Filter budget dropdown by transaction date when editing a transaction
description: When assigning a budget to a transaction (in the detail panel or inline edit), the budget dropdown currently shows all non-archived budgets. Instead, filter budgets to only those whose date range (startDate–endDate) covers the transaction's date. This way, editing an old transaction shows only budgets that were active at that time (not newer ones), and editing a recent transaction doesn't show expired budgets. phase: CI: Optimize CI/CD Pipeline with Change Detection
title: Move change detection to the first CI step and skip unnecessary jobs
description: Currently the CI/CD workflow runs all static checks and tests before detecting what changed. Restructure the GitHub Actions workflow to detect changed files as the very first step (e.g., using dorny/paths-filter or git diff against the base branch), then conditionally skip jobs that aren't affected by the changes. Target mapping (needs exploration during implementation to find the right balance between reliability and optimization): (1) Unit tests — run if src/ or tests/unit/ changed. (2) API integration tests — run only if backend code changed (src/, tests/integration/, drizzle/). Skip if only frontend or scripts changed. (3) E2E tests — run if backend (src/), frontend (web/), E2E tests (e2e/), or Docker config changed. (4) Static checks (typecheck, lint) — run if any source code changed (src/, web/, tests/). (5) Build/deploy — existing change detection logic. (6) Changes to scripts/, docs/, or other non-production files should not trigger test runs. During implementation, explore: how to handle shared config files (package.json, tsconfig, etc.) that affect multiple categories; whether to use path filters per job or a single detection job with output variables; how to ensure reliability so that skipping doesn't accidentally miss regressions (e.g., always run everything on main branch merges as a safety net).

title: Persist UI state in localStorage via useLocalStorage hook
description: UI elements like the left sidebar (collapsed/expanded), right transaction filter sidebar (collapsed/expanded), selected transaction filters, and other toggleable states reset to their defaults on page reload. Fix by: (1) Create a useLocalStorage<T>(key: LocalStorageKey, initialValue: T) hook in web/src/hooks/use-local-storage.ts with the same API as useState but backed by localStorage. Handle SSR (return initialValue during server render, sync from localStorage on mount), JSON serialization/deserialization, and storage errors gracefully. (2) Define a LocalStorageKey enum or const object in web/src/lib/local-storage-keys.ts with all keys in one place (e.g., SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED, FILTER_SIDEBAR_COLLAPSED, TRANSACTION_FILTERS) to prevent key collisions and make usage discoverable. (3) Replace useState calls for these UI states with useLocalStorage throughout the app: left sidebar collapse state in app-shell.tsx, transaction filter sidebar visibility, applied transaction filters (account, category, budget, type, status, date range, search), and any other toggleable UI state that should persist across reloads. For filters, persist the appliedFilters object so returning to the transactions page restores the last-used filter set. URL params should take precedence over localStorage when present (e.g., navigating from a budget link).

title: Wire transaction_sources creation at runtime
description: transaction_sources join table (linking bank_transactions to transactions) is never populated at runtime. Add linkTransactionSource(transactionId, bankTransactionId) and linkTransactionSources(links[]) abstract methods to BankTransactionRepository. Implement in DatabaseBankTransactionRepository using INSERT INTO transaction_sources ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING. Wire into TransactionSyncService: in saveBankTransactions(), after saving bank_transactions (which return entities with IDs), build externalId→bankTxId map, match with transaction dbIds, and call linkTransactionSources(). In saveSingleBankTransaction(), call linkTransactionSource() after save. Add stubs in SpreadsheetBankTransactionRepository. title: Fix amount sign convention (transactions.amount always positive)
description: transactions.amount should always be positive (type column indicates direction), but the write path still stores signed amounts from Monobank. Fix: (1) In MonobankMapper, use Math.abs() when creating Transaction entities (bank_transactions keep signed amounts). (2) In DatabaseTransactionMapper, rename calculateSignedAmount → getAmount and update comments. (3) Create scripts/fix-amount-sign.ts one-time script: UPDATE transactions SET amount = ABS(amount) WHERE amount < 0 (fixes ~250 negative debits in production). (4) Document convention in CLAUDE.md Data Conventions section. Run script with --dry-run first, then apply. Write unit tests for mapper changes.

title: Redesign returning detection using single-transaction model
description: Current returning detection creates two transaction rows (original + returning). Redesign to single-transaction model: partial refund → ONE transaction linked to TWO bank_transactions (original amount reduced), full refund → ZERO transactions (both bank_txs orphaned). Update TransactionSyncService.detectReturningForTransaction(): (1) Classify incoming transaction as cancellation (bank description starts with 'Скасування. '). (2) Find original debit via findCancellationCandidate(). (3) Partial refund: reduce original amount, link cancellation bank_tx to original via transaction_sources, delete cancellation transaction. (4) Full refund: delete both transactions. Update TransactionProcessingService.processCancellation() to set transaction: null. Write unit tests for new behavior.

title: Wire fee-split detection at runtime
description: Transactions with commission > 0 are saved with full amount — no separate fee transaction is created. Add detectFeeSplits() to TransactionSyncService: for each transaction where bank_transaction has commission > 0, (1) reduce main transaction amount by commission, (2) create separate fee transaction (type='debit', amount=commission, description='Bank commission', same date/account/currency), (3) link fee transaction to same bank_transaction via transaction_sources. Wire into use cases after returning detection. Write unit tests.

title: Wire detection into all use cases with correct ordering
description: Wire detectReturnings() and detectFeeSplits() into ProcessIncomingTransaction, SyncTransactions, and SyncMonobank use cases. Order: returnings first (may delete transactions), fee splits second (adjusts amounts), transfers last (existing). If detectReturnings deletes the saved transaction (full refund), skip fee splits, transfers, and categorization. Update existing use case unit tests to verify the new detection calls with correct ordering.

title: Remove RETURNING type from codebase
description: Eliminate the RETURNING transaction type since returnings are now handled by amount reduction on original transactions. (1) Domain: remove RETURNING from TransactionType enum, remove 'returning' from type unions. (2) GraphQL: remove RETURNING from TransactionTypeEnum, remove adjustedTransactionId from Transaction type, remove markAsReturning/unmarkReturning mutations. (3) Resolvers: remove markAsReturning/unmarkReturning handlers. (4) Mappers: remove 'returning: RETURNING' from type map. (5) MonthlyOverviewResolver: remove 'returning' exclusion filter (only 'transfer' remains). (6) Frontend: remove RETURNING from TYPE_CONFIG in transactions-table.tsx and transaction-detail-panel.tsx, remove from filter options. (7) Delete tests/integration/api/mark-as-returning.test.ts. Run just check && just test && just test-api.

title: Create production data fix script for returnings and amounts
description: Create scripts/fix-returning-data.ts to fix production data in three phases: (1) Make all transaction amounts positive: UPDATE transactions SET amount = ABS(amount) WHERE amount < 0. (2) Process all 15 cancellation bank_txs into single-transaction model: for each cancellation, find matching original, handle partial (reduce amount, link bank_tx) or full (delete both txs) refund. Categories: 2 already type='returning', 5 still type='credit', 8 orphaned. (3) Clear adjusted_transaction_id: UPDATE transactions SET adjusted_transaction_id = NULL. Support --dry-run flag. Verify: no transactions with type='returning', no negative amounts, no adjusted_transaction_id values.

title: Update seed data with bank_transactions, transaction_sources, transfers, returnings, fee splits
description: Update scripts/seed-local-db.ts: (1) Add clearDatabase for transfer_pairs, transaction_sources, bank_transactions tables. (2) Create bank_transactions for each seeded transaction (map from transaction fields). (3) Create transaction_sources links. (4) Add 2 transfer pair examples per month (debit on one account, credit on another, same amount, ~1min apart). (5) Add returning examples: partial refund (one debit with reduced amount linked to 2 bank_txs) and full refund (orphaned bank_txs, no transaction). (6) Add fee split examples: main tx with reduced amount + separate 'Bank commission' debit, both linked to same bank_tx. Also update test factories in tests/integration/api/test-factories.ts with createTestBankTransaction(), createTestTransactionSource(), createTestTransferPair().

title: Transfer UI improvements: skip categorization prompts and consistent display
description: Improve transfer transaction display on the frontend: (1) In transactions-table.tsx, for type='transfer' rows: hide category/budget comboboxes (show '-' or 'Transfer' label instead), remove the verify button (transfers don't need verification), don't show 'Categorized' warning badge. (2) In transaction-detail-panel.tsx, for transfers: hide category/budget selectors, hide verify button, show transfer pair info (linked transaction ID/description if available). (3) In CategorizeTransactionUseCase or EnqueueCategorizationUseCase, skip categorization for transfer transactions. (4) In ProcessIncomingTransaction, skip enqueueing categorization for transactions detected as transfers. Write unit tests for skip logic.

title: Add returning indicator for partially returned transactions
description: Add visual indicator for partially returned transactions on the frontend. After P9-003, a partially returned transaction is a debit linked to >1 bank_transactions (original + cancellation). (1) Add bankTransactionCount field to Transaction GraphQL type (or use existing bankTransactions field count). (2) In transactions-table.tsx, show a small 'Returned' badge or icon next to debit transactions where bankTransactionCount > 1. (3) In transaction-detail-panel.tsx, show both bank_transactions in a collapsible section with original and cancellation amounts. (4) Update GetTransactions and GetTransaction queries to include bankTransactionCount. Run codegen.

title: Write comprehensive tests for Phase 9 changes
description: Ensure test coverage for all Phase 9 changes: (1) Unit tests: TransactionSyncService — transaction_sources linking, detectReturnings (partial/full refund, no match), detectFeeSplits (reduce amount + create fee tx). (2) Unit tests: updated use cases — verify detection ordering (returnings → fees → transfers), skip processing after full refund deletion. (3) API integration tests: query partially returned transaction (bankTransactionCount > 1), query fee-split transactions, verify RETURNING type no longer accepted in filters. (4) Update mocks: add findCancellationCandidate, updateTransactionAmount to TransactionRepository mock; add linkTransactionSource, linkTransactionSources to BankTransactionRepository mock.

title: Update documentation for Phase 9 changes
description: Update project documentation to reflect Phase 9 changes: (1) docs/database-design.md — document transaction_sources usage, single-transaction returning model, fee split model. (2) docs/data-flow.md — update transaction processing flow diagram with returning/fee/transfer detection ordering. (3) CLAUDE.md — update Data Conventions section with amount sign convention (already partially documented). (4) Mark Phase 9 tasks as completed in ROADMAP.md.

title: Verify and fix createTransaction backend
description: The createTransaction GraphQL mutation and CreateTransactionUseCase already exist but may have issues. Verify: (1) accountId mapping — GraphQL input uses Int (DB ID), but use case may use externalId internally. Test the mutation end-to-end via API integration test. (2) Amount conversion — input accepts Float in major units, use case should multiply by 100 for minor units. Verify Math.round(request.amount * 100). (3) Error handling — ManualTransactionNotAllowedError for synced accounts, account not found. (4) Return value — mutation should return the created Transaction with all fields. Fix any issues found. Write API integration test: create transaction on manual account (happy path), reject on synced account, validate required fields.

title: Add frontend GraphQL operation and create transaction form component
description: Build the create transaction form: (1) Add CreateTransaction mutation to web/src/graphql/mutations/transactions.graphql, run codegen. (2) Create web/src/components/transactions/create-transaction-sheet.tsx — Sheet with form: account selector (manual accounts only, fetched from GetAccounts with source filter), date picker (default today), amount input (positive number, shows currency from selected account), type radio (Expense/Income), description text input (required), counterparty name (optional), notes textarea (optional). (3) Form validation: amount > 0, description non-empty, account selected. (4) On submit: call CreateTransaction mutation, refetch transactions list, show success toast, close sheet. (5) Add data-qa attributes for E2E testing. Follow patterns from create-account-sheet.tsx and other Sheet components.

title: Add create transaction entry points in UI
description: Add entry points to open the create transaction form: (1) In transactions page header (next to the page title), add a '+ Add Transaction' button that opens CreateTransactionSheet. Only show when user has at least one manual account. (2) In the accounts page, on manual account rows, add a 'Record Transaction' option in the account dropdown menu that navigates to /transactions with the account pre-selected in the create form. (3) Consider adding a floating action button or keyboard shortcut (Ctrl+N) for quick access. Add data-qa attributes.

description: Add E2E test coverage for manual transaction creation: (1) Create e2e/tests/transactions/create-manual-transaction.spec.ts. (6) Ensure seed data includes at least one manual account for E2E tests.

description: Update scripts/seed-local-db.ts to include sample manual transactions: (1) Ensure at least one manual account exists in seed (e.g., 'Cash' account with UAH currency).
